Who Receives Technical Violations?

Who receives technical violations?

  1. What proportion of youth on probation supervision receive a technical violation during a probation term? How does this vary across race/ethnicity, sex, and risk level?

  2. Descriptive overview of the population of youth who receive a technical violation during the study period (when technical violation was the primary offense) by race/ethnicity, age category, sex, and risk level

  3. What proportion of violations filed by a PO are rejected by supervisor or prosecutor?


1. Technical Violations Overview

NOTE: All analysis of technical violations in this section (e.g., supervision episodes with at least one technical violation) refers to the filing of any technical violations regardless of outcome/disposition.
